lines.welcome: Welcome to the bead atelier. Pick a necklace to make!
lines.mode-ab: Make a two-bead pattern: one, two, one, two.
lines.mode-abc: Make a three-bead pattern: one, two, three, then repeat.
lines.mode-free: Make your very own necklace. Any beads you like!
lines.intro-ab: Follow the two-bead pattern. Thread the glowing spot next.
lines.intro-abc: Follow the three-bead pattern. Thread the glowing spot next.
lines.intro-free: Choose any bead. Start at the left and make it yours.
lines.drag-cue: Through the hole, then slide it home!
lines.off-target: Bring the bead to the glowing spot.
lines.pattern-round: Round, barrel, round, barrel. Find the round bead.
lines.pattern-barrel: Round, barrel, round, barrel. Find the barrel bead.
lines.pattern-three: Round, barrel, diamond. What comes next?
lines.cheer-ab: You followed the pattern. What a beautiful necklace!
lines.cheer-abc: Three beads, then repeat. You did it!
lines.cheer-free: Your necklace is one of a kind!
lines.wear-prompt: Tap the fox to see the necklace!
lines.wear-cheer: Look what you made. It fits perfectly!
